significance: Solapur's central temple, built in an island setting within a lake by the yogi Siddharameshwar, a 12th-century Shiva devotee revered as a god in the Lingayat faith, who took samadhi here in 1167 CE and installed sixty-eight lingams in the courtyard. A marble samadhi marks the spot, and the temple and lake have been managed by the Shri Siddheshwar Devsthan Panch Committee since 1899.
story: Solapur is said to have begun prospering from the moment Siddheshwar was born.
